messages:
maya: Heads up — canary p95 decode jumped ~35% after today's runtime merge. Noticed during load tests.
perf-bot: CI perf-check failed on canary: decode_p95 +33% vs baseline. Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/1234
maya: Heap of traces look like attention path. Short sequences are being batched weirdly and kernel selector picks matmul_fused_v2 a lot.
 sasha: I captured a quick trace: 
```
op: attention_batched_matmul  time: 62% total
op: transpose_attn_opt    time: 18% total
kernel chosen: matmul_fused_v2
seq_len_dist: 8/8/128/8/8/256 
```
 sasha: same job on previous deploy used transpose_attn_opt for majority and p95 was normal.
anika: That smells like the new concatenation-aware batching heuristic. We introduced an entropy threshold to prefer fused kernels when seq variance low — maybe it's inverted.
liam: Running git bisect locally now. If selector rule changed in PR #8872 that would be the suspect.
perf-bot: Bisect suggestion: probable range 8870..8885. Hot candidate: PR 8872 (kernel-selector: concat-batcher heuristic).
maya: @raj can you hold the canary rollout? We've got customer traffic soon.
deploy-bot: Canary hold engaged by @raj — stopping further rollout to region-us-west-2. Reason: perf regression detected. :no_entry_sign:
raj: Held. Can confirm production instances still on previous build.
liam: Quick repro script to trigger the issue: `python tools/bench.py --pattern short-mix --batcher concat --runs 200` — gives reproducible p95 uplift.
anika: Preliminary fix: flip the entropy comparator and add a guard that if avg_seq_len < 12 prefer transpose_attn_opt. Small patch ready.
liam: Can we ship a revert for PR 8872 now to unblock? I can open PR.
sasha: Bisect pointed to 8872 and a small follow-up 8890 that tweaks thresholds. 8872 is the root change.
liam: Opened revert: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8929 — includes revert & unit test for selector behavior.
maya: Also add a quick perf test in CI to catch this class: bench decode_p95 short-mix baseline < +5%.
perf-bot: Noting CI perf-check triggered: add regression guard ticket created INF-1427.
raj: After revert lands we'll re-run canary perf and if green we can continue rollout. ETA for revert merge ~20m.
deploy-bot: Patch rolled back in canary staging by PR 8929 merged. Starting canary validation.
liam: Post-revert perf sample: p95 back to baseline within noise (±2%). Running extended sweep.
anika: Follow-up action: refine concat heuristic, add unit+perf tests, and ensure KV cache path doesn't change batching decisions.
maya: Thanks everyone. Keep thread updated if any anomalies crop up during extended sweep. :thumbsup:
